misleading_chart_audit.title: GPU Kernel Optimization Makes Inference 86% Faster Everywhere!
flaws: False attribution: Labels host sync/launch reduction as 'GPU Kernel Optimization' when GPU kernels were only 13.64% of runtime.
Missing units & truncated Y-axis: Exaggerates visual bar difference by starting Y-axis above zero.
Over-generalization ('Everywhere!'): Hides Day 48 seq_len=512 CPU regression (+220.42% slower).

bounded_assumption_break.assumption: Hardcoded Y-axis ceiling of 200 ms is sufficient for all latency comparisons
bounded_assumption_break.failure_symptom: Clipped bars exceeding 200 ms: ['CPU FP32 Baseline (seq=512)', 'CPU FP16 Candidate (seq=512)']
bounded_assumption_break.fix: Dynamic zero-based Y-axis scaling (0 to 2000 ms) with explicit p50 ms labels

hardware_telemetry.gpu_target: NVIDIA Tesla T4 (15360 MiB VRAM, FP16 Tensor Core 65 TFLOPS, 320 GB/s HBM)
hardware_telemetry.local_cpu_target: WSL2 Ubuntu x86 CPU (No FP16 Tensor Cores; FP16->FP32 fallback on long prefill)
